identity.title: Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu's Challenge!

leadText:
----
(Japanese: Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu's Challenge!) is a Pokémon manga composed by Hiroshi Takase and illustrated by Makoto Mizobuchi. It was serialized in the CoroCoro Ichiban! magazine from the July 2015 issue (released on May 21, 2015) to the December 2016 issue (released on October 21, 2016), with a single chapter published in the issue 50 of (released on September 20, 2016). The manga utilizes quizzes and puzzles as a method of storytelling. It is 160 pages long.
